200.description: The transaction and, once processed, its outcome.

code.description: Error code. For a downstream refusal, the owning context's `Err...` identifier.

path.description: JSON path of the offending request field, when known.

errors.description: Always present on a processed transaction (empty on `SUCCESS`).

nodeId.description: Set on a `SUCCESS` `NODE_REGISTRATION` transaction: the id node-topology gave the node (G30).

poNumber.description: Set on `ACKNOWLEDGEMENT` and `SHIPMENT_CONFIRMATION` transactions: the purchase order they concern.

404.description:
The resource does not exist (`not-found`), or it belongs to another vendor
(`ErrNodeNotOwnedByVendor`, problem type `node-not-owned-by-vendor`, 404 so a vendor cannot probe another vendor's nodes).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next call.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.
